related.title: Alertmanager：抑制規則的租戶鍵與空值陷阱
related.titleEn: Alertmanager: tenant keys and missing-label inhibition traps
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付評估時間表、狀態轉移圖、重設與缺資料樣本，以及觀察、持續、通知三段延遲。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver evaluation schedules, state transitions, reset/missing-data fixtures and separate observation, persistence and notification delays.
related.difference: 用合成警示建立source、target、tenant、cluster四欄真值表，先界定允許被抑制的範圍。
related.differenceEn: Build source, target, tenant and cluster truth tables for synthetic alerts, defining allowed inhibition scope beforehand.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 若第一次觀察true在t0，後續評估皆true，首次可觸發時間是滿足持續時間的下一個評估點。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 每30秒評估，t=0為false，t=30起持續true；for=120秒，忽略排程抖動與通知延遲。 pending從30開始，首次firing在150秒；若實際異常從1秒開始，觀測與持續條件另引入延遲。
抑制可減少重複通知但不刪除事件；跨租戶誤抑制的代價需單獨計數而非視為降噪成功。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 有12筆target，A租戶8、B租戶4；A故障source本應只抑制A的8筆，缺tenant鍵卻抑制全部12筆。 錯誤抑制4筆，占原12筆target的33.333333%；本課不用此比例推論整體風險。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With true first observed at t0 and every later evaluation true, firing begins at the first evaluation satisfying the duration. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Evaluate every thirty seconds: false at zero and continuously true from thirty onward, with for=120 seconds and no scheduling jitter. Pending starts at thirty and first firing occurs at 150 seconds; an actual onset at second one introduces additional observation delay.

Inhibition reduces notifications without deleting events; cross-tenant suppression must be counted separately from useful noise reduction. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Twelve targets include eight in tenant A and four in B; an A source should inhibit eight, but a missing tenant key suppresses all twelve. Four targets are suppressed incorrectly, or 33.333333% of the original target set, without implying a global risk probability.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: The Sleuth Kit mactime：MACB欄位展開與事件去重邊界
related.titleEn: The Sleuth Kit mactime: MACB expansion and event-count boundaries
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付評估時間表、狀態轉移圖、重設與缺資料樣本，以及觀察、持續、通知三段延遲。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver evaluation schedules, state transitions, reset/missing-data fixtures and separate observation, persistence and notification delays.
related.difference: 保存檔案身份、來源檔案系統、時間屬性標籤與原始精度；計算時間觀測數，另列同時間的屬性群，不推論未被觀測的操作。
related.differenceEn: Preserve file identity, source filesystem, timestamp-attribute labels and original precision. Count timestamp observations, separately group coincident attributes, and avoid inferring operations that the evidence does not directly identify.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 若第一次觀察true在t0，後續評估皆true，首次可觸發時間是滿足持續時間的下一個評估點。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 每30秒評估，t=0為false，t=30起持續true；for=120秒，忽略排程抖動與通知延遲。 pending從30開始，首次firing在150秒；若實際異常從1秒開始，觀測與持續條件另引入延遲。

mactime將body file的時間資料整理為時間線；MACB代表不同時間屬性，具體語意隨檔案系統而異，相同時間不必然相同事件。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 10個合成檔案，各有4個已知時間欄位，共40觀測；其中6檔四欄相同，其餘4檔四欄皆不同。群鍵為檔案ID加時間值。 按檔案與時間群組得到6×1+4×4=22群；40/22=1.818182只是觀測對群比例，不是動作去重的真實倍率。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: With true first observed at t0 and every later evaluation true, firing begins at the first evaluation satisfying the duration. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Evaluate every thirty seconds: false at zero and continuously true from thirty onward, with for=120 seconds and no scheduling jitter. Pending starts at thirty and first firing occurs at 150 seconds; an actual onset at second one introduces additional observation delay.

mactime organizes temporal fields from a body file into a timeline. MACB denotes different timestamp attributes whose exact meaning depends on the filesystem; equal timestamps need not imply one shared underlying operation. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Ten synthetic files each have four known time attributes, totaling forty observations. Six files have four equal values; four have four distinct values. Group by file identity and timestamp value. Grouping by file and timestamp produces 6×1+4×4=22 groups. The 40/22=1.818182 ratio compares observations to groups; it is not a verified deduplication factor for user actions.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
